articles.title: CORTIS: The Crew Rewriting K-Pop’s Style Code
articles.description: CORTIS arrive in the June 2026 W Korea digital cover moment like a flash of color cutting through a monochrome feed — young, self-possessed, and impossible to reduce to a single mood. Built as BIGHIT MUSIC’s “Young Creator Crew,” the five-member group has turned debut-era curiosity into a full visual identity, and this cover signals how quickly they’ve moved from new names to cultural shorthand. The group that refuses one lane CORTIS were introduced as MARTIN, JAMES, JUHOON, SEONGHYEON, and KEON
articles.summary: CORTIS, a five-member group under BIGHIT MUSIC, has developed a distinctive visual identity since their debut and is featured on W Korea's June 2026 digital cover. The group, initially introduced under different names, has quickly become a cultural reference point for their diverse and self-possessed style.
